text: theme_airfryer(): Air fryers small countertop convection ovens blow hot air around food (see Convection oven Wikipedia). Air fryers went novelty common kitchen appliance 2020s. Philips launched first Airfryer 2010, 2018 people used name brand. 36% US households convection oven 2020. 2023, estimated 60% one. 2024 UK study, one five people said air fryer cooking device used . palette follows colors popular Crispi air fryer comes : Cherry Crush, Sage Green, Electric Cobalt, Butter Yellow, Cyberspace navy, Frosted Lilac Stone. image shows air fryer basket reheated potatoes kitchen counter. code: set.seed(2020) fryer <- data.frame(food = rep(c("Fries", "Wings", "Nuggets", "Veggies"), each = 80)) fryer$minutes <- round(rnorm(320, mean = c(Fries = 15, Wings = 22, Nuggets = 10, Veggies = 12)[fryer$food], sd = 2.5), 1) ggplot(fryer, aes(x = food, y = minutes, fill = food)) +   geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +   labs(title = "Air fryer cook times", caption = "Simulated data", x = NULL, y = "Minutes") +   theme_airfryer(base_size = 13)
